Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre: Parking, Upcoming Shows and Concert Rides

Scottsdale Sprinters’ short answer on Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre: it is the outdoor concert venue at 2121 North 83rd Avenue in Phoenix, not the Talking Stick Resort casino in Scottsdale. Its lots typically open 30 minutes before the gates, and the gates usually 60 to 90 minutes before the show. The drop-off and pick-up area is on the west side through Gate 3, and rideshare pickup is on Palm Lane. For a group, one chauffeured vehicle replaces the lot, the pickup line and the drive home.

Last updated: September 24, 2026

How does parking work at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre?

Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre’s parking lots typically open 30 minutes before the scheduled gate time, and gates usually open 60 to 90 minutes before the show. Parking is sold show by show on the venue’s parking page, and its upgrades include Premier Parking, a short walk from the gates, and Easy Out Parking near the West Gate (Gate 2) for the fastest exit. Reserved Premier Parking is a guaranteed space at the front of the Premier lot, held all night whether you arrive early or late; it is for cars only. The venue also sells an oversized space for a limousine or an RV in the Premier lot. Every upgrade is limited. No tailgating is allowed, and no overnight parking: an unauthorized vehicle on site before or after an event is towed at the owner’s expense. Accessible parking is inside Gate 3 and Gate 6 off Encanto Boulevard, first come, first served, for a state-issued placard or plate; the venue suggests arriving when the lots open. The venue’s pages publish no parking price: parking is sold per show, and the box office handles parking refunds and upgrades.

Where is the drop-off and rideshare pickup at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre?

The venue’s drop-off and pick-up area is on the west side of Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre, through Gate 3: tell parking staff you are dropping off and they show you the way. To pick up, arrive at least 45 minutes before the show ends, or you will not be able to enter. Rideshare riders meet their car on Palm Lane, on the southwest side of the venue. That is the area a chauffeured group uses too. We tell parking staff we are dropping off, unload the group through Gate 3, and are back inside the pick-up area before the 45-minute cutoff, so the group walks out to its own vehicle instead of joining the rideshare line on Palm Lane. A group that splits across cars also splits across lots, gates and exits. One vehicle arrives with everyone at once and leaves with everyone at once.

Where is Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre, and is it at Talking Stick Resort?

Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre is at 2121 North 83rd Avenue, Phoenix, AZ 85035, in Maryvale on the west side of Phoenix. It is not at Talking Stick Resort: the venue says plainly that it is not the same location as the Talking Stick Resort & Casino, which is in Scottsdale. Talking Stick Resort is the amphitheatre’s name-in-title sponsor. Live Nation, which runs the venue, renamed it in January 2023; it was the Ak-Chin Pavilion before that. The venue has hosted concerts for over 30 years. By Google’s typical drive time, measured on September 24, 2026 without show traffic, the amphitheatre is 16 minutes from downtown Phoenix, 20 minutes from Phoenix Sky Harbor, 29 minutes from Old Town Scottsdale, 34 minutes from the Talking Stick Resort casino and 38 minutes from Kierland. Show nights add the venue’s own traffic to the last mile.

What time do gates open at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre?

Gates at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre usually open 60 to 90 minutes before showtime, and the parking lots about 30 minutes before the gates. The exact gate and parking times for each show are posted on the venue’s Need-to-Know page closer to the date. There are two main entry gates, the West Gate and the East Gate, and some shows open only one. The box office is open on show days only: the West Box Office from noon, the East Box Office about an hour before doors, card only. Re-entry is not permitted: once you leave, you need a new ticket to come back in. Events are all ages unless the show says otherwise, and shows go on rain or shine, barring severe weather.

What is the Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre bag policy?

Only small clutches, wristlets or fanny packs up to 6 by 9 inches, or clear plastic bags up to 12 by 12 by 6 inches, are allowed inside Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre. All bags are subject to search at entry, with metal detectors and sometimes a pat-down. Not allowed: backpacks and other bags outside the policy, coolers of any size, outside food or drink except factory-sealed water, alcohol, glass, cans, metal hydroflasks, lawn chairs, strollers, laser pointers, selfie sticks and aerosol sunscreen. Factory-sealed, unfrozen water up to one gallon per person is allowed, and refill stations are inside. The venue is cash-free: guest services swap cash for a card at no charge. Settle bags at the hotel; a group that is dropped off has no car in the lot to go back to during the show.

How many people does Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre hold, and how does the lawn work?

Live Nation describes Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre as a 20,000-seat outdoor venue. The lawn is always first come, first served: a row or seat number on a lawn ticket is only for the box office’s tracking, and there are no assigned seats on the lawn. Lawn chairs can be rented for most shows and are the only chairs allowed inside; blankets are not permitted at some shows. For a large party, the venue’s Premium Seating department sells VIP boxes, suites and clubs that hold more guests than the standard ticket limit. For a group, the lawn decides the ride: arriving together at gate time is how a crew gets a spot together, and leaving together is how it gets home.

Which vehicle fits a Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre group?

Concert crews ride the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax), the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) or the Party Bus (28 Pax). A VIP night takes the Maybach Jet Sprinter, the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter, the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter or the Luxury SUV (Suburban). Corporate and big groups take the Executive Black Sprinter, the Executive White Sprinter, the Mini Bus (24 Pax), the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) or the 56-Passenger Motorcoach. Seat counts are seated capacities from the fleet: the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter seats 15, the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) 13, the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) 16, the Party Bus (28 Pax) 28 and the Maybach Jet Sprinter 9. The Executive Black Sprinter seats 14, the Mini Bus (24 Pax) 24, the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) 29 and the 56-Passenger Motorcoach 56. Our pick for a night on the lawn is the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter, $250 an hour with a 4-hour minimum: fiber-optic lighting with eighteen modes, an ultra-premium sound system with subwoofers, a wet bar with champagne glass holders and a full partition with an intercom to your chauffeur. The Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) is $175 an hour with a 4-hour minimum, and the Executive Black Sprinter is $145 an hour with a 4-hour minimum. Every rate prices the whole vehicle, before tax. Count riders for the ride home as well as the ride there; the late list is the one that matters. For a group bigger than one vehicle, we plan two or more and quote them together.

How should a group plan the ride to a Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre show?

Plan backwards from the show time. Gates usually open 60 to 90 minutes before the show, so a pickup that lands the group at the Gate 3 drop-off around gate time leaves room for the lines, the bag check and a spot on the lawn. The ride home is the part to plan hardest. The venue lets pickups into its pick-up area only until 45 minutes before the show ends, so your chauffeur is in place before the encore and the group walks straight out to its vehicle. Book by the hour and the vehicle is yours for the whole night, dinner before the show included, or book a ride there and a ride back. Reach the reservations team at (623) 986-6339 or reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com with the show, the date, the pickup area and the rider count.

Frequently asked questions

Where do you park at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre?

In the venue’s own lots, which typically open 30 minutes before the gates. Parking is sold per show, with Premier Parking a short walk from the gates and Easy Out Parking by the West Gate (Gate 2) for the fastest exit. No tailgating and no overnight parking.

How much is parking at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre?

The venue’s pages publish no price: parking is sold per show on the venue’s parking page. Premier, Reserved Premier and Easy Out spaces cost more and are limited.

Where is the rideshare pickup at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre?

On Palm Lane, on the southwest side of the venue. Drop-off is on the west side through Gate 3; tell parking staff you are dropping off.

Can a limo or party bus drop off at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre?

Yes, in the venue’s drop-off and pick-up area on the west side through Gate 3, as parking staff direct. For the ride home the vehicle must be in the pick-up area at least 45 minutes before the show ends, or it cannot enter.

Is Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre at Talking Stick Resort?

No. The amphitheatre is at 2121 North 83rd Avenue in Phoenix; the Talking Stick Resort & Casino is in Scottsdale, about 34 minutes’ drive away. The venue says they are not the same location.

What time do gates open at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre?

Usually 60 to 90 minutes before showtime, with the lots about 30 minutes before the gates. Exact times are posted for each show on the venue’s Need-to-Know page.

What is the Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre bag policy?

Small clutches, wristlets or fanny packs up to 6 by 9 inches, or clear bags up to 12 by 12 by 6 inches. No backpacks, coolers or lawn chairs of your own.

Can you tailgate at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre?

No. The venue allows no tailgating and no overnight parking.

How many people does Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre hold?

Live Nation describes it as a 20,000-seat outdoor venue, with a first-come, first-served lawn.

Can you leave and come back in at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre?

No. Re-entry is not permitted; leaving means a new ticket to come back in.
